_comment: Strict 401k prohibited symbol list. Used by importers/schwab/rules_401k.rs to flag holdings and open orders. Add new tickers here without code changes.

_notes.leveraged_etfs: Any 1.5x, 2x, or 3x bull/long fund. Banned in strict 401k.
_notes.inverse_etfs: Any -1x, -2x, -3x short / inverse / bear fund. Banned in strict 401k.
_notes.mlp_symbols: Master Limited Partnerships - generate UBTI, prohibited per most 401k plans. OKE is a C-corp now but kept for safety; remove if needed.
_notes.name_pattern_fallback: If a symbol isn't on these lists but its description contains 'Ultra', 'Pro', '3x', '2x', 'Leveraged', 'Inverse', 'Short', or 'Bear', it is also flagged.
